description: The bar chart, titled “Model Evaluation on Academic and Human Preference Benchmarks,” visually compares the performance of two model variants—labeled “Ours (Iterative)” in blue and “Ours (Iterative)” in orange, though the legend appears to be mislabeled or duplicated—across nine distinct evaluation datasets and metrics: GSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LC AlpacaEval-2, MT-Bench (×5), and Chat-Arena-Hard. The vertical axis, labeled “Score (%)”, ranges from 0 to 80 in increments of 10, indicating performance as a percentage. The horizontal axis lists the evaluation benchmarks in a fixed left-to-right order. For each benchmark, two adjacent bars represent the scores of the two model variants. In most cases, the orange bar (intended to represent “Ours (Iterative)”) is taller than the blue bar, suggesting higher performance, with notable exceptions such as HumanEval and LC AlpacaEval-2 where the blue bar is slightly shorter. The highest scores are observed on MBPP (both bars near 80%), while the lowest are on LC AlpacaEval-2 (blue ~70%, orange ~80%). The chart uses a tilted perspective and 3D-style rendering, with the legend positioned in the top-right corner, though it lacks distinct labels for the two orange/blue variants, potentially indicating a labeling error. The overall layout emphasizes comparative performance across diverse academic and human preference-aligned benchmarks, consistent with the paper’s focus on RLHF workflow evaluation.
